title: WEAPON SPAWN
features:
Spawns machete in front of your character 
NOTE : You can change what you want to spawn expect for bat and crowbar
script:
--You can change the weapon you want to spawn by changing the 2.line of the script like name Chainsaw instead of Machete if you want an chainsaw
--It doesnt spawns bat and crowbar for some reasons
local hrp = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
local saw = workspace:FindFirstChild("Machete") or workspace.Ignore:FindFirstChild("Machete")
saw:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -2))
